notes.title: Auditorium Update Released
notes.content: This update fixes the end-of-game announcement thanking users for playing the demo version of the game. Credits now roll instead. This update also significantly improves upon the quality of graphics at higher resolutions. Graphics are now rendered by GPU instead of CPU, allowing for smoother pixel interpolation. Auditorium's native resolution is still 830x466 pixels.

notes.title: Auditorium Goes Live on Steam as Duet Kickstarter Launches
notes.content:
Today is an exciting day for us here at Cipher Prime. [i]Auditorium[/i], after long last, has finally made its way to Steam! It's available now in the Steam Store for both PC and Mac.

But wait, what's this about a Kickstarter? We thought what better time to announce the sequel to [i]Auditorium[/i] than with the release on Steam. Like with [i]Auditorium[/i], we're looking to our fans to help fund a portion of the development costs through donations. Instead of PayPal donations, this time around we've turned to Kickstarter. Watch the video, let us know what you think, and help us out if you can. For a more in-depth, behind the scenes look at Cipher Prime and our [url=http://www.cipherprime.com/kickstarter][i]Auditorium 2: Duet[/i] Kickstarter[/url], Joystiq has the exclusive.
